prompts: ID_B and ID_C are two young male engineers in their late twenties, wearing casual tech-company hoodies and glasses, with anxious exhausted expressions. ID_B has short black hair and ID_C has slightly longer messy hair. The scene is a bright modern R&D laboratory with white walls, computer monitors, scattered hard drives, cables, and test prototypes on the desk. At normal speed, ID_B and ID_C huddle around a desktop computer, frantically typing and pulling their hair in frustration. The monitor displays red error messages reading extreme transfer test failed and storage overflow in bold red text, flashing repeatedly. ID_B says in a panicked young male voice, "This speed is completely stuck! Even 8K raw footage cannot run!" ID_C shouts in an equally stressed voice, "Large capacity test crashed again! This is the eighth time this week!" The shot uses a medium framing that captures both engineers and the glowing error-filled screen. The visual style is a bright clean tech-lab comedy with exaggerated anxious facial expressions and fast-paced energy. Rapid keyboard typing sounds, repeated error alert beeps, and tense fast-paced background music fill the audio. The camera remains stable at medium distance, emphasizing the crisis atmosphere.

ID_A is a middle-aged Chinese man in his fifties with a calm weathered face, short gray-streaked hair, and an unassuming humble appearance. ID_A wears a wrinkled gray-blue janitor uniform with a cleaning bucket strap over one shoulder and holds a mop. ID_A's voice is a deep calm male voice with flat understated delivery and quiet confidence hidden beneath ordinary speech. ID_B and ID_C remain the same two young anxious engineers from the previous shot. At normal speed, ID_A slowly mops past the desk area, casually glances at the computer screen, and stops with the mop leaning against the floor. ID_B waves a hand impatiently without looking closely and says, "Sir, could you please move aside? We are really busy here!" ID_A responds in a flat calm tone, "Oh? This problem?" The shot is a medium group composition showing the contrast between the frantic engineers and the slow-moving janitor. Bright laboratory lighting, mop dragging friction sounds on the floor, and a brief pause in the background music create comedic contrast. The mouth movement of all three characters remains naturally synchronized with dialogue.

ID_A is the same middle-aged janitor in gray-blue uniform with calm focused expression. ID_A's voice remains deep and understated. At normal speed, ID_A reaches into the pocket of the janitor uniform and pulls out a sleek metallic solid-state drive with a clearly visible HIKSEMI logo on the front. ID_A casually plugs the drive into the computer and clicks the mouse twice with effortless precision. Cut to close-up of the monitor: a green transfer progress bar instantly fills to one hundred percent, speed numbers skyrocket dramatically, and the test result screen shows all tests passed in bright green text. No spoken dialogue in this shot, only crisp plug-in sound, a whoosh of ultra-fast data transfer, and rising electronic speed-indicator tones. The visual style is bright high-tech with clean reflections on the metal drive, sharp focus on the HIKSEMI branding, and satisfying sci-fi transfer aesthetics. Hand close-ups alternate with screen close-ups. The comedy comes from how casually the impossible fix happens.

ID_B and ID_C are the same two young engineers, now with eyes wide open and mouths forming perfect O shapes in cartoon-level shock. ID_A is the same middle-aged man, now standing confidently in front of the desk. At normal speed, ID_B and ID_C lean toward the monitor in disbelief, then slowly turn their heads toward ID_A. ID_A calmly removes the drive, brushes dust off the uniform, and pulls off the gray-blue janitor jacket to reveal a crisp white dress shirt underneath with a name badge reading Product Director Chen. ID_A straightens the tie with composed authority. ID_B and ID_C say in unison with stunned voices, "Who are you?!" ID_A speaks in a steady authoritative male voice, "Hikvision Storage — fast, stable, high capacity. When nothing else works, this is what you need." The shot uses a medium push-in on ID_A during the reveal, with dramatic clothing rustle, gasps of shock, and background music shifting instantly to bold heroic energy. Exaggerated comedy reaction faces on the engineers contrast with ID_A's calm confidence.

ID_A is again in janitor mode, bending down to pick up the mop and cleaning bucket with unhurried movements. ID_B and ID_C stand frozen in the background, still in shock, staring at each other with blank confused expressions. At normal speed, ID_A turns away from the engineers and slowly walks forward while mopping the floor along a cabinet, completely returning to ordinary janitor behavior. ID_A says over the shoulder without turning back, "By the way, I have not finished mopping the floor yet." ID_B and ID_C remain motionless, exchanging bewildered glances. The shot is a wide comedic tableau: foreground mopping action, background stunned engineers. Mop friction sounds, awkward comedic silence, and a light funny musical sting underline the absurd reversal. The visual tone is bright workplace comedy with strong deadpan humor and physical comedy spacing.

The final shot is a clean brand closing composition. In the center foreground, a high-definition product hero shot of a Hikvision storage solid-state drive with a sharp clear HIKSEMI logo on the metallic surface, lit with premium tech-product studio lighting. In the softly blurred background, ID_A continues mopping as a distant gray-blue silhouette, maintaining the running gag. At the bottom of the frame, clean subtitle text reads Hikvision Storage — Experts hide in plain sight in Chinese and English style branding typography. No character dialogue, only a confident brand closing musical hit and a light comedic outro sting. The visual style is polished commercial finish: bright, minimal, premium tech branding with subtle comedy in the background blur. Static or very slow push-in camera, crisp product detail, and cinematic depth of field.
